about: Prediction ledger (operator 11/07): before a result lands, each forecaster writes a concrete expected outcome. Scored after. Over time this shows, with numbers, whether Claude is too pessimistic and Argon too optimistic, and on which kinds of question each is reliable. Add Argon's forecasts verbatim as the operator relays them.

small positive day delta (cuts the -70..-80 bp tail) but fewer than 60% of days better
